page.layout: One printed page, one column of running text, with no head. The page number is at the top right. The running head is at the top centre. The catchword is at the right below the last line, and the gathering signature is at the lower left. Faint marks at the left edge and at the bottom right are show-through or stains and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Romæ confulibus, ad muniendum ne-gocium, quod turbare exceptionibus Callicrates conabatur, non solum eos, qui convocari communiter solent, sed omnes etiam xxx annis majores, anni-tente Lycortâ cum filio Polybio, qui re-gibus Ægypti studebant, ad concilium venisse: & quanquàm voluntatem mul-titudinis in sententiam suam Lycortas vertisset, tamen astu Callicratis conatu -excidisse. Sed rarum id, & à communi ratione recedens. Hoc verò fixum, & certâ lege sancitum, ne liceret prætori & Demiurgis concilium gentis Achaicæ convocare, nisi de societate jungendâ, aut bello suscipiendo esset deliberan-dum. Eratque alia lex, ne iidem concilium indicerent, nisi legati concilium petentes mandata suorum adferrent, eaque scripta exhibérent. Quâ lege Q. Metellus concilium flagitans ad agen-dam Lacedæmoniorum causam repul-sam tulit, ideoque cum stomacho è Græciâ discedens cum Romam rediis-set, acerbè apud senatum in Achæos, in-primis in Philopœmenem & Lycortam invectus, iisque contemptum majesta-tis Romanæ & studia inimica obje-ctans non parum senatus animos in A-chæos asperavit, & eorum consiliorum suasor primus fuit, quæ ad Achæorum per-

page.notes: The first word of the page continues the previous page's paragraph. The printed "venisle", "rediif-" and similar forms use long s and are copied here as plain s. "exhibérent" carries an accent as printed; it may be a printer's mark, so it is doubtful. A stray dash stands before "excidisse" at the start of the line; it is copied as printed in the first position but may be a printing mark. The catchword "per-" and the signature "q 5" are printed at the foot.
